items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-08-30
items.q: That was the man that run the... Chalmette in the camp. He was commander of all these men... That's Dr. Nelson.

ctx.x: This... This... This young man here... Uh... This... That man there. That was the man that run the... Chalmette in the camp. He was commander of all these men. And he was running that man there. Well he died. And after he died... This man here took it. And he run it. Until 1950. And he died. And then after that... I took it.
